policy: Historical prototype outputs are coverage references only. They are not gold truth, acceptance thresholds, or targets that new implementations should imitate blindly.

historicalArchitecture.sceneSegmentation: LLM semantic supervisor proposes scene start phrases; deterministic string anchoring slices original chapter text
historicalArchitecture.tension: integer 1-10 per scene followed by global aggregation

knownLimitations: Counts were produced by the historical LLM-heavy prototype and were not independently gold-annotated.
Multiple independent model requests caused rate limits, long runtimes, timeout risk, and repeated overlapping context transmission.
New local-first experiments should compare coverage and qualitative behavior, but quality decisions require fresh source-grounded evaluation.
